target: run-engine under-recovery Variant A/B — find a shape fix (sigma stretch / center-gap stretch / additive quality-uncertainty variance) that restores the recovered quality-margin spread (audit c1a7c12: 59-67%) to ~100% without degrading totals or derived-ML calibration
scope: READ-ONLY A/B against the pinned 1,376-row decided OOF store — no production/model change unless GATE_PASS (separate adoption commit). Evidence = decided OOF rows only. mechanism_mapping.recovered_spread_metric: audit methodology (MLB 39c865e mirror): mean margin per sextile of each quality feature; recovery % = predicted sextile-5-minus-0 spread / actual spread, averaged over elo_diff / ewm_net_pts_diff / win_pct_diff / ewm_ypp_diff

knobs.per_side_means: mu_h / mu_a from the era walk (E2 ewm_2w centers + 12-pool diff LGBM, median rounds 20/23) — carried unrounded in the OOF artifact
knobs.joint: pinned DN const-sigma joint: sigma_h 9.663 / sigma_a 9.0789 / rho 0.0076 / tie 0.275% -> margin sigma 13.2086, totals sigma 13.3092
knobs.totals: P(total > line) from the total PMF of the SAME joint — any per-side sigma change moves totals too (the gate's cross-check)

variant_definitions.V1: per-side const sigma x k (k in 1.00..1.50 step 0.05) — scales BOTH margin and totals sigma (honest DN stretch); mu pair untouched
variant_definitions.V2: gap scale k around the pair mean: mu'_h = m + k(mu_h - m), mu'_a = m + k(mu_a - m) — total mean preserved exactly, joint params pinned; k in 1.00..1.80 step 0.05
variant_definitions.V3: global additive quality-uncertainty variance: sigma0' = sqrt(sigma0^2 + c*mean(mu_gap^2)), c in {0.1, 0.5, 1.0} — the pinned const-const joint cannot carry per-game sigma (documented limitation); last-resort arm

V0_identity.mechanism: pinned params, identity mu — must reproduce the pins

V1_sigma_stretch.mechanism: per-side const sigma x k (scales BOTH margin and totals sigma — honest DN stretch; mu pair untouched)

V2_gap_stretch.mechanism: gap scale k around the pair mean: mu'_h = m + k(mu_h - m), mu'_a = m + k(mu_a - m) — total mean preserved exactly, joint params pinned

V3_quality_variance.mechanism: global additive variance: sigma0' = sqrt(sigma0^2 + c*mean(mu_gap^2)) — the pinned const-const joint cannot carry per-game sigma; last-resort arm
